meta.title: While one handler is suspended, the worker runs another
meta.subtitle: Handler A releases the thread at co_await, the worker finishes B, and A resumes when the reply arrives

messages.label: the worker moves on at once — handle() runs

cards.title: Suspending stops only that flow
items: When handler A suspends at co_await, only that flow stops; the thread returns to the pool and nothing is held.
The worker picks up the next item and runs B, which finishes before A's reply arrives.

cards.title: Blocking undoes this
items: When the reply lands, A resumes in place and co_returns — which is how a handful of workers absorb many concurrent requests.
A blocking wait inside a handler pins its thread for the duration, so it is not allowed.
